ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All rounding in SwapMath and SqrtPriceMath consistently favors the protocol. amountIn rounds UP, amountOut rounds DOWN, fees round UP. Verified via Forge test: 50 round-trip dust swaps produced zero profit.

_setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at AMMModule.sol:3190 preserves the ENTERED bit. TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:70 does `currentGuard = _getTstorish(REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE) & ENTERED` before clearing flags. All nonReentrant entry points check ENTERED bit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan cross-token fee denomination mismatch (INV-S04)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: When feeToken != loanToken, separate balance checks at L3313-3314 correctly track each token independently. Fee stored via _storeHookFees(loanToken, feeToken, ...) with correct keying. Collection via collectHookFeesByHook transfers feeToken (not loanToken).
All hook callbacks in AMMStandardHook.sol have _requireCallerIsAMM() (L940-944: msg.sender == AMM). CLOBTransferHandler has equivalent check at L230, L316.

feeOnTop not signed in SWAP_TYPEHASH, but limitAmount IS signed and caps total user exposure. For input swaps: total collected = amountSpecified (signed). For output swaps: total collected <= limitAmount (signed). Previously submitted as finding #8, rejected by contest judges.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage slot collision between diamond and queued fees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Diamond storage at slot 0x9A1D, queued fee transient storage at 0x9A1D00000000000000000000. Mapping-based diamond storage uses keccak256 for slot computation — no realistic collision.
Known false positive per audit memory. AMM calls beforeSwap per-token, second intentionally overwrites first. By-design behavior.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill fee rounding in unchecked block (L1413-1427)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: expectedLPFee/expectedProtocolLPFee scaled with mulDivRoundingUp (rounds against trader). exchangeFeeAdjustment/protocolExchangeFeeAdjustment use mulDiv for refund (rounds down = less refund = against trader). adjustedAmountSpecified stays slightly larger but balance check at L2208 demands exact amount from trader.
Intentional design — pool/liquidity hook fees are always denominated in the same token they're charged against. All call sites confirm tokenFor == tokenFee for this path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ERC777 reentrancy during queued hook fee execution
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Even if ERC777 callback fires during safeTransfer at L3133, hook can only call collectHookFeesByHook which falls through to _transferHookFeesByHook with underflow protection at L3130. Queue already zeroed at L3189. No double-collection possible.
Forge test confirms: swap A->B then B->A results in net loss. 50 dust round-trips also result in net loss. All rounding favors protocol.

Concentrated liquidity uses absolute liquidity units (L^2), not share-based accounting. No totalShares/totalAssets ratio to manipulate. Token amounts computed from getAmount0Delta/getAmount1Delta with sign-aware rounding.

Reserves decremented before transfer (L578-590). If transfer fails, tokens stay in contract but are tracked as owed. collectTokensOwed uses check-effects-interaction (zero storage before transfer, revert on failure). No double-spend.
